title: Raw API request bodies (file: exporter) keep an earlier Read of credentials (i2)
reason_not_testable: The leak is in the OpenTelemetry file exporter's stored request bodies on later turns. No fixture kind observes exporter storage, and the storage behaviour is UNVERIFIED in the catalog. Non-hook controls: config lint that OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES and file: mode are absent from managed settings, and rotation of any value already stored.
